decision_conditions: Condition : 1 - The development hereby permitted shall be begun before the expiration of three years from the date of this permission.
Condition : 2 - The materials to be used in the construction of the external surfaces of the outbuilding hereby permitted shall be as specified witihn the application form.

Condition : 3 - The proposed development shall be carried out in all respects in accordance with the proposals contained in the application and the plans submitted (Location Plan received on 31/07/2015
KGS/CAR/510P1B/1, KGS/CAR/510P1B/2 received on 03/09/2015) therewith and approved by the Local Planning Authority, or as shall have been otherwise agreed in writing by the Local Planning Authority before the building is used.

Condition : 4 - No additional windows or other glazed openings shall be formed in the  side and rear walls of the outbuilding hereby approved and no additional doors inserted in the building without the prior written consent of the Local Planning Authority.

Condition : 5 - The outbuilding hereby permitted shall only be used for purposes incidental to the occupation of the dwelling known 35 Carlton Close and shall not be occupied as separate or ancillary residential accommodation or for business use.
description: Erection of a single storey outbuilding at the rear garden of the house
